cell.description: Cell width and height in pixels.

terrains.description: The surface terrains, as `gamearts_layered_map.py build --terrains` reads them (id, symbol, colours, priority, walkable).

occluders.description: Optional colour-defined things that stand on the ground, as `build --occluders` reads them.

occlusion_mask.description: Optional picture the size of the scene, white where something stands on the ground, relative to the job file.

solid_mask.description: Optional picture, white where a solid structure stands; its cells block movement.

environment.description: The environment objects: a `gamearts-props-job` (classes of tree, fence, hedge, prop and so on, each with a mask). Structures and characters are refused.
